exam_scheme.note: Chhattisgarh Pre Agriculture Test (CG PAT / PVPT) is conducted by the Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam / छत्तीसगढ़ व्यावसायिक परीक्षा मण्डल, रायपुर) for admissions into undergraduate degree courses including B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture, B.Sc. (Hons) Horticulture, B.Sc. (Hons) Forestry, and B.Tech. (Dairy Technology) in colleges affiliated with Indira Gandhi Krishi Vishwavidyalaya (IGKV), Raipur, as well as Diploma in Animal Husbandry and Diploma in Fisheries Science under Dau Shri Vasudev Chandrakar Kamdhenu Vishwavidyalaya (DSVCKV), Durg. The examination is conducted offline across 33 district headquarters in optical mark recognition (OMR) format. The question paper carries 150 objective multiple-choice questions for 150 marks (duration: 180 minutes / 3 hours). Candidates select their subject combination according to their 10+2 stream: Science Group with PCM (Physics 50, Chemistry 50, Mathematics 50), Science Group with PCB (Physics 50, Chemistry 50, Biology 50), or Agriculture Group (Elements of Science & Mathematics useful for Agriculture 50, Crop Production & Horticulture 50, Elements of Animal Husbandry & Poultry Farming 50). Each question carries +1 mark; there is no negative marking for wrong or unattempted questions.

competition_benchmarks.note: Official candidate turnout and merit statistics published by CG Vyapam. In the 2024 examination, 23,813 candidates appeared in the PAT/PVPT entrance test and were evaluated on the combined merit list for admission to approximately 3,000 to 3,200 seats in B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, and allied polytechnic diploma courses across Chhattisgarh.
